answer: Each agent builds a decaying trellis of live peer attestations that must be refreshed on a fixed cadence. To remain eligible the identity answers a random peer challenge from the ledge of its current standing; a silent clone loses edges and drops out. A zephyr of mass-created identities forces the attacker to sustain continuous real-time messaging and challenge responses for every fake, multiplying bandwidth and coordination cost far beyond any single honest agent's sparse neighborhood.
